tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page and dialog ground. Text on it is `foreground`, secondary text `muted-foreground`.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text and icons on `background`, `card`, `popover`, `secondary` and `field` (at least 12:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: The second surface: panels, stat tiles, the notes sidebar, empty states. A step darker than the page in light (an inset well), a step lighter in dark (raised).

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card` (alias of `foreground`).

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, select lists, hover cards and dialogs (alias of `background`), set apart by a `border` hairline and `shadow-menu` or `shadow-dialog`.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover` (alias of `foreground`).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The pastel coral fill (alias of `coral`) of the one main action per view, the selected segment, a checked box and the active chip. Its label is `primary-foreground`, never white. The same in both themes.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` (alias of `coral-foreground`; 8:1).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Quiet filled buttons and pressed toggles: a fill that shows on both `background` and `card`.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary` (alias of `foreground`).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Tracks of segmented controls and tab lists, skeletons, disabled fills.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, metadata, uppercase labels, placeholders, on `background`, `card`, `muted` and `popover` (4.6:1 light, 5.1:1 dark). Not on `secondary` in light (4.3:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and keyboard-highlight fill of menu items, ghost buttons and select options (alias of `secondary`).

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent` (alias of `foreground`).

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions: text, borders and invalid-field edges on `background` and `card` (4.7:1 light, 6.4:1 dark), and the solid fill behind `destructive-foreground`. Always with a word: delete, not saved.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `destructive` fill (5.7:1 light, 6.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card, menu and dialog outlines, dividers, section rules, the segmented track's edge. Decorative only; it is never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: input

tokens.name: ring

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Inside of inputs, selects and textareas: white in light, near-black in dark. Typed text on it is `foreground`.
